Experience implementing agentic workflows and multi-agent architectures. Proven ability to work closely with Product and stakeholders to understand business needs, gather requirements, and translate them into scalable AI solutions. Strong communication skills in English, including the ability to explain technical concepts to different audiences. Willing to commute to our Reforma office for a hybrid work schedule. Our team designs, manages and operates DoorDash's massive and growing global network of support centers, with the ultimate goal of delivering a world-class customer experience every time. This role will play a vital part in improving forecast accuracy, reporting, and planning around floor staff utilization and efficiency. Forecast incoming contacts based on Delivery volume, Mx and Dx onboarding. Analysis on historical data to provide insights that improve support operations. Guide Short-Term staffing adjustments to address current staffing gaps. Work with our operations team to track how our staffing is being implemented and optimized. Make proactive and corrected improvements. Partner with Real Time Analysts for demand insight and outage reporting. Produce, dig into and use data and insights to identify opportunities to improve speed, quality, effectiveness, and customer experience Partner with teams within integrity, customer experience, and our product, engineering, and tools teams to improve processes and the resulting customer experience for consumers, merchants, and dashers, and helping DoorDash become a safe and trustworthy platform Accomplish your recommendations from start to finish, from digging into Excel/SQL to creating a budget to implementing timelines, aligning partners, testing ideas, achieving and measuring results Identify areas for improvement and/or innovation around efficiency and customer experience from deep dives and understanding customer's cases; drive new ideas to be built and tested We're excited about you because… Analytical and data driven - you love getting into the weeds. Impeccable follow-up and follow-through capabilities, you can execute and get the job done. Comfortable in a fast-paced, constantly changing, team-oriented environment and able to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously. Have an owner mentality; you're focused on quality, output driven, an extreme hustler, proactive, and always pushing yourself to do better. You are eager to bring solutions to big challenges in creative new ways You like to dig in. You don't hesitate to get in the weeds and operate at the lowest level of detail, but you're as comfortable thinking long-term and inspiring a team. You're unafraid of the unknown. Rapid change and learning is exciting to you, and you excel in constant change. You love data. You let data win arguments, and you're comfortable pulling data or modeling in Excel/Google Sheets. You don't give up. If your plan doesn't work, you have 3 more options in your back pocket. You have 4+ years of post-grad experience. As our reporting operation evolves, you will play a key role in reducing manual effort, improving consistency, and helping automate reporting wherever possible. Process Documentation & Standardization Develop and maintain SOPs, Work Instructions, reporting templates, and process documentation. Capture process improvements, lessons learned, and operational knowledge to build standardized reporting practices. Identify opportunities to improve reporting quality, efficiency, and consistency. Responsibilities You will be responsible for supporting the design, implementation, validation, and optimization of digital analytics solutions. You will work closely with business, marketing, data, and technology teams to translate business needs into measurable requirements, technical specifications, and actionable insights. You will contribute to the implementation and evolution of Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics, ensuring that data collection, dimensions, metrics, events, dashboards, and reports are aligned with business objectives and measurement strategies. Validate data collection and troubleshoot tracking, ingestion, attribution, and reporting issues. Analyze customer behavior across digital channels and identify insights that support business and marketing decisions. Collaborate with development, tagging, data, marketing, and business teams to ensure consistent and accurate data collection. Support the definition of KPIs, measurement frameworks, and reporting standards. Identify opportunities to improve data quality, analytics processes, reporting capabilities, and platform adoption. Develop knowledge of Adobe Experience Platform and understand how datasets, schemas, identities, and customer profiles support Customer Journey Analytics use cases. Preferred Skills And Experience Intermediate or advanced knowledge of Adobe Analytics. Technical knowledge of Adobe Customer Journey Analytics is highly recommended. Experience with analytics implementation, data validation, debugging, reporting, or dashboard development. Understanding of digital measurement concepts, customer journeys, KPIs, attribution, segmentation, and data quality. Knowledge of Adobe Experience Platform is preferred; candidates must be willing to develop technical proficiency in AEP. Knowledge of Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK, Adobe Tags, data layers, or similar data collection technologies is a plus. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills. Ability to collaborate with business and technical stakeholders in multidisciplinary and global environments.
